mapper.select: SELECT customer_id AS id, customer_name AS title, customer_code AS number, status, dept_id AS scope_dept_id, owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND (customer_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR customer_code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')

SELECT ticket.ticket_id AS id, ticket.ticket_title AS title, ticket.ticket_no AS number, ticket.status, CASE WHEN ticket.portal_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket.owner_id = #{userId} THEN #{deptId} ELSE customer.dept_id END AS scope_dept_id, CASE WHEN ticket.portal_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket.owner_id = #{userId} THEN ticket.owner_id ELSE customer.owner_id END AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_service_ticket ticket INNER JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = ticket.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = ticket.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE ticket.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket.deleted = 0 AND (ticket.ticket_title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR ticket.ticket_no LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
